objectives:
幫助學生達到成為一個合格股權分析師的最基本要件
Helping students equip with basic skillsets of a qualified equity research analyst
content:
財務模型建立，實務股權評價觀念與技巧，公開演講技巧
Financial models construction, basic valuation methodology, presentation skills
books:
以業界經驗與教師本身自有教材為主，無教科書
Mainly self-prepared materials and experience sharing
teaching_method:
講授
研討

個別指導
grading_policy:
課堂作業 (class assignment)： 20%
課堂參與 (class participation)：30％
期末報告 (final presentation)：50％
